newsitem.title: CHINA: Cheung Kong sells Vista Paradiso flats.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong sells Vista Paradiso flats.

text.p: Cheung Kong Holdings Ltd said on Monday its offer of a total 894 units at its residential development Vista Paradiso in Shatin in the New Territories had all been sold on the first day of sale.
"We offered a total 894 units for sale and all the units were sold on first day of sale on Saturday," said Kenneth Yuen, senior manager of advertising department of Cheung Kong.
"We also sold 600 carparking spaces at prices ranging from HK$500,000 to HK$520,000 each on the following day," Yuen said.

Cheung Kong had offered 692 units before adding on another 202 units on Saturday due to the strong market response. The latest batch of flats were sold at HK$6,800 to HK$7,000 per square foot, Yuen said.
Vista Paradiso, a joint-venture project equally owned by Cheung Kong and Concord Land Development Co Ltd, has about 2,030 residential units.
The first phase of the development comprises 1,012 units of which about 10 percent were earmarked for private sale and the remainder were offered to the public, Yuen said.

"Buyers for the flats were mainly end-users. In accordance to the registration response, only about five percent of the buyers were registered under company names and 95 percent was under individual names," Yuen said.
"On the first day of sale, I saw that about 97 to 98 percent of the buyers were those registered under their own names," Yuen said. "The response are satisfactory."
Yuen said Cheung Kong is awaiting government's consensus on sale of the second phase of the development, but he declined to comment further.
